description: How a session leader's -c string reads: the agent's command shown to the user, and every sudo in command position with its arguments (null for a word an expansion may change), or sudos null when the string can't be read with certainty. Shared by the Rust module (native/t3-elevation/src/shell_words.rs) and the clients (packages/client-runtime/src/elevationCommand.ts). See docs/internals/device-approval.md, Session grants.

commands.name: two_sudos
commands.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y nginx
commands.agentCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y nginx

commands.name: heredoc_body
commands.command:
sudo tee /etc/x <<'EOF'
sudo rm -rf /
EOF
sudo id
commands.agentCommand:
sudo tee /etc/x <<'EOF'
sudo rm -rf /
EOF
sudo id

commands.name: case
commands.command: case x in a) sudo id;; esac
commands.agentCommand: case x in a) sudo id;; esac

commands.name: if
commands.command: if true; then sudo id; fi
commands.agentCommand: if true; then sudo id; fi

commands.name: negation_and_loop
commands.command: ! sudo id; for f in a b; do sudo rm "$f"; done
commands.agentCommand: ! sudo id; for f in a b; do sudo rm "$f"; done

commands.name: not_command_position
commands.command: FOO=1 sudo id; time sudo id; nohup sudo id; eval 'sudo id'; bash -c 'sudo id'
commands.agentCommand: FOO=1 sudo id; time sudo id; nohup sudo id; eval 'sudo id'; bash -c 'sudo id'

commands.name: comments
commands.command:
# sudo rm -rf /
sudo id # sudo ls
echo a#b sudo ls
commands.agentCommand:
# sudo rm -rf /
sudo id # sudo ls
echo a#b sudo ls
